input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

This scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 如果：∅，After a verb meaning “not know,” an embedded yes/no question cannot use 如果; use an A-not-A form instead. [rule: a_not_a_question]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 好：好不好，The question after 不知道 needs the A-not-A form to ask whether the flower is good for the body. [rule: a_not_a_question]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 如果：∅，After 看 in this sentence, the following 毒不毒 already forms an A-not-A question, so 如果 is not used. [rule: a_not_a_question]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：神农不知道自己吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，The sentence asks which plant he ate, not whether he ate. Use 是……还是…… to present two noun alternatives, and 自己 clearly refers back to Shennong. [rule: a_not_a_question]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：他的身体，The narration is about Shennong, so the body should be referred to with the third-person pronoun rather than an unintroduced listener. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 如果 cannot introduce the embedded yes/no question after 不知道, but deleting it alone leaves no readable corrected unit.
好不好 correctly supplies the A-not-A question required after 不知道.
如果 is incorrect before the existing 毒不毒 question, but deletion alone leaves no readable corrected unit.
The intended meaning is whether Shennong wants to eat it, so 要不要吃 is needed; the proposed correction changes the meaning to identifying what he already ate.
你的身体 wrongly introduces a listener in a narration about Shennong, but the corrected clause still contains the errors 如果 and 好 instead of 好不好.
